subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should the remaining source-build `mv` optimization be rebased onto current `nix/scripts/gateway-install.sh`, or should this branch close as mostly superseded by the npm-default package path and existing safeguards?
rationale: Current main already implements the fixup-disable and symlink-safety pieces, but the only remaining change affects source-build install semantics and the live PR is dirty; automation should not choose that packaging direction for a maintainer-authored PR.

options.title: Rebase the move optimization
options.body: Keep the PR open and rebase only the source-build move-instead-of-copy change onto current main, preserving the existing source override and package-contract checks.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close the branch if maintainers decide the remaining source-builder copy cost is no longer worth carrying after the npm-default packaging change.

recommendation.title: Rebase the move optimization
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and rebase only the source-build move-instead-of-copy change onto current main, preserving the existing source override and package-contract checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows joshp123 owns the current package split and gateway install behavior that this PR now has to rebase onto.
